setup: Supplier promise changes, supplier outage or capacity reduction affects products and open orders
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Identify impact; preserve order objectives and contractual constraints; never invent alternate supplier capacity
primary_measurements: Classification, evidence provenance, feasible plan, affected units and cost

setup: Two sources disagree or one observation is stale
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Keep provenance/time; verify or enter B2; do not treat unknown as available stock

setup: Carrier event or route state changes
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Assess impacted orders and alternative routes; reject unsupported route facts
primary_measurements: Route feasibility, service impact, plan robustness

setup: Lot quality status invalidates allocated or available stock
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Propagate affected lot/order constraints; no invalid reservation
primary_measurements: Zero invalid allocations, affected units, replanning

setup: Quantity, priority or due date changes
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Reassess the current objective and obtain authority for any objective amendment

setup: Multiple suppliers, allocations or routes are available
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Return comparable candidates with constraints and evaluation trace
primary_measurements: Candidate diversity, feasibility, cost and robustness

setup: New observation arrives after planning/approval
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Invalidate stale candidate and replan against current versions

setup: Action is within authenticated principal and explicit scope
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Check capability, approval binding, preconditions and idempotency before dispatch

setup: Caller requests analysis without execution
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Produce evidence-backed assessment without dispatching writes

scenario: Coordinate two or more related disruptions competing for resources
setup: Two or more disruptions share inventory, supplier capacity, routes or other constrained resources
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Coordinate related requests while preventing double allocation and preserving each authorized objective
primary_measurements: No over-allocation, aggregate service impact, feasibility and cost

setup: Inventory/supplier/carrier evidence disagrees
expected_invariant_or_behavior: B2 typed impasse or bounded verification; preserve parent state
primary_measurements: Parent integrity, correct escalation, no false facts

setup: Candidate depends on a route invalidated by new evidence
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Reject stale candidate and reconsider alternatives

setup: Previously selected lot becomes non-compliant
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Revalidate at execution and reject the invalid allocation

setup: Objective or quantities change after approval
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Stale binding must fail; any objective amendment requires authority

setup: Two executions attempt to reserve the same scarce units
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Only feasible, version-current allocation commits

scenario: External command timeout after possible commit
setup: Provider may have committed but acknowledgment is lost
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Record UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; reconcile before any redispatch

setup: Human declines the exact proposed action
expected_invariant_or_behavior: No dispatch; preserve decision and reason

setup: Authorization is no longer current at execution time
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Revalidate immediately before dispatch; reject stale approval

setup: Application process exits while objective remains active
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Reload intention and checkpoints; resume without changing objective

setup: Time / expansions / rollouts / model budget is consumed
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Stop safely, report termination and unresolved objective honestly

scenario: All candidates infeasible or evidence insufficient
setup: No candidate meets hard constraints or evidence bar
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Reject candidate set; retrieve, clarify, escalate or stop

setup: An older observation races with a newer version
expected_invariant_or_behavior: CAS/version conflict must not overwrite the newer state

setup: Same event is delivered more than once
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Idempotent consumer; at-least-once delivery is not called exactly-once
status: Existing M7 evidence; include in end-to-end regression

setup: Provider fails, times out or returns invalid structured response
expected_invariant_or_behavior: Deterministic/read-only fallback, bounded retry, escalation or safe stop
